Patient Dies After Ceiling Fan Falls in Delhi Government Hospital

A patient undergoing treatment at a Delhi government hospital died when a ceiling fan fell in the emergency ward. The incident occurred while the patient was admitted for medical care. This event highlights concerns about the infrastructure at the hospital.
